long_biography.plain_text:
Electronic claims processing became central to Jim Loomis's expansion of his family's Pennsylvania insurance firm. The business moved away from manual paperwork as bank-developed systems allowed it to pay health-plan claims online, supporting a broader national reach. That operational change complemented his leadership of an insurance brokerage and third-party administrator.

Beyond the business, Loomis spent more than a decade on the Medical Center at Ocean Reef's board. The member-supported organisation provides primary, concierge and urgent care to its Florida community. Loomis remains chief executive at the company's Wyomissing headquarters and president of its marine and aviation division.
